# AGENT: .github

- **CI shape (Packages job in `ci.yml`):** file-only checks (`test:scripts`, `check:skill-counts`) run before the build so they fail in seconds; one `turbo build typecheck lint test --concurrency=3` call schedules the four tasks together (3 is the measured sweet spot on a 4-core, 16 GB runner: about 8 GB peak); `check:exports`, `check:dist-imports` and the Figma catalog check come last. The `Generated files` job runs `pnpm catalog:check` (one pass of `pnpm catalog:sync` over every committed derived file, failing with the full list of stale files); after any catalogue change run `pnpm catalog:sync` and commit. `release.yml` repeats only what publishing depends on and reuses the Turbo cache. `blazor.yml` always runs the cheap verification and runs the expensive part (build benchmarks, trimming matrix, browsers) only when `packages/blazor/**` (manifest excluded), `apps/blazor-app/**` or the workflow changes, and on every push to `main`. Renovate rebases only on conflicts (`rebaseWhen`), so a red grouped PR does not rerun every workflow on each push to `main`.
